topic.title: variant in VALUE
topic.p: Extracts the active payload from a variant as object, evaluating VALUE once. It shares the right-associative unary precedence of +, -, not and cast. For example, cast int variant in value extracts the payload and then performs an ordinary object-to-integer cast. Nonvariant operands are compiler errors, even when an object contains a variant box provided by native C++ code. Extraction removes one layer only; it preserves the value held by an active object option.

ul.li: For integers, returns the bit-wise reversed value of VALUE.
For bool, switch true and false.
It is not allowed on other types.
